title: Equivalence relations, partitions, and quotients
summary: Group elements into classes, build quotient sets, and determine which maps are independent of representatives.
abstract: An equivalence relation groups elements that agree in a specified respect. Its classes form a partition, and the collection of classes is a quotient set. We prove how these descriptions fit together, when a rule on representatives defines a map on classes, and why the fibres of a map recover its image.
